summary: Explore execution plans, compare results, and arrange your SQL workspace around the way you work.

changes.title: Graphical execution plans
changes.text: Inspect Actual, Live and Estimated plans, open and save .sqlplan files, and navigate with pan, zoom, fit, an operator outline and a properties inspector. Available diagnostics include runtime counters, predicates, parameters, memory grants, spills and missing-index details.

changes.title: Plan history and comparison
changes.text: Retain and pin plan snapshots, reopen them after executing again or closing a query tab, and compare retained or saved plans side by side. Plan history lasts until the workbench window closes or reloads.

changes.title: Analyze the results you already have
changes.text: Sort by multiple columns without executing SQL again. Search cells and columns, inspect column profiles and histograms, show row sizes and whitespace, and compare against a previous result. Copy and export follow the displayed order.

changes.title: Arrange your workspace
changes.text: Split, stack and float query editor groups. Pin queries on separate shelves and adjust shelf heights. Move Object Explorer, Results, Messages or Execution Plan panels into their own operating-system windows and return them to the main window.

changes.title: Inspect objects and find them faster
changes.text: Peek at supported objects' definitions, properties, columns, parameters, dependencies and top rows in a card or document tab. Search Objects adds fuzzy matching, searches across connected servers and a details pane.

changes.title: Shortcuts, statistics and memory visibility
changes.text: Customize scoped keyboard shortcuts and supported mouse modifiers, with conflict handling, import/export and resets. Client Statistics compares per-execution counters, while the status bar shows search-index and retained-result memory use.

changes.title: Safer recovery and more reliable focus
changes.text: Preserve restored query text through renderer crashes and Windows session ends, protect newer external file edits when saving restored tabs, and improve docking, detached-panel focus, tab overflow and workspace restoration.

changes.title: Plan capture depends on server permissions
changes.text: Automatic Actual plan capture requires Extended Events permissions. Live plans require a supported server and profiling permissions. Estimating a plan in the query session is an explicit action; the ordinary estimate uses a separate connection.

changes.title: Bounded, in-memory analysis
changes.text: Results, searches, profiles, comparisons and plan history stay within memory limits. Varia reports truncation, partial data and estimates. Builds remain unsigned, and macOS builds are not notarized.
